description: Remove project and last_projected from Subscriber struct. Change subscriber key from {owner_pid, fiber_id, slot_index} to {owner_pid, request}. Add projections field: %{{fiber_id, slot_index} => {fn, last_projected}}. Add add_projection/remove_projection operations. Update notify_observers to iterate per owner_pid, run all projections, collect only changed values, send one batched {:filament_observable_updates, [{fiber_id, slot_index, value}]} message per subscriber. One Process.monitor per server per LiveView instead of per fiber. handle_subscribe returns raw state as initial_value.
title: Refactor Subscriber struct and Observable.GenServer fan-out
